Academic Departments and Centers of Dr. B.K.B. College
Dr. B.K.B. College has successfully implemented the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) in eleven(11) different undergraduate programmes under Gauhati University and currently has eleven (11) departments and one (01) center, i.e. Computer Centerfor smoothfunctioning of theprogrammes offered by the college. The college has efficaciously introduced three new subjects, viz., Sociology, Psychology and Performing Arts (Sattriya Dance) (Dr. B.K.B. College is the 1st college of Assam, which has successfully introduced Performing Arts (Sattriya Dance) as a subject in the undergraduate course) in the session 2015-2016 and also introduced UGC approved skill based programmes, viz.,B.Voc. in IT and Physical Education and Diploma in Cosmetology and Sattriya Dance in the session 2020-2021. The college has also successfully introduced B.Com (Bachelor in Commerce) programme in the session 2017-2018 in self-financing mode.
